Explicit Java native load alone sanitizes; writes a separate sibling inode, opens it, then unlinks it. Original library remains unchanged.
ttmplayer DT_NEEDED names libmffmpeg.so. Exact fecf91e1 mffmpeg has one 8-byte init-array slot, zero value, no relocation targeting the slot.

Dependency loader reuses by shortname or device/inode. Explicit temporary-path mapping has no canonical libmffmpeg shortname; the original canonical file has a different inode. Merely preserving SONAME is not sufficient in this source.
If relocation reaches constructor dispatch for the reopened original, it calls the null entry without the bionic skip. DT_NEEDED does not call ART SanitizeInitArray.

qualification: OH musl source is release-matched, not byte-rebuilt against the deployed ldso. This is a static admission rejection based on supplied exact ART/object facts and OH loader implementation, not a claim that a new on-device SIGSEGV has occurred. An earlier relocation failure may precede constructor execution.

smallest_candidate_direction.preferred: Reuse the existing bionic null-slot transformation as a deterministic derived libmffmpeg artifact at the single canonical file reached both by Java absolute path and DT_NEEDED. For this exact input only, verify whole SHA, sole unrelocated null slot and change DT_INIT_ARRAYSZ from 8 to 0; retain all other bytes. Then ART no longer creates a second sanitized inode and the dependency lookup can reuse the same inode.
smallest_candidate_direction.required: Independent candidate/source-transform receipt and exact output SHA; guarded per-file original backup/CAS/rollback; recursive actual namespace/provider closure remains necessary. This adds one explicit derived deployment object and requires the corresponding narrow allowed-file update before use. No application data changes.
smallest_candidate_direction.alternative: If changing the loader instead, keep a canonical sanitized object reachable by exact dependency basename within that namespace and ensure Java and DT_NEEDED resolve the same inode/handle. Merely omitting unlink, setting RTLD_GLOBAL, appending TARGETS, adding SONAME, or reordering Java load calls is insufficient. This is more invasive than the exact derived artifact.
smallest_candidate_direction.not_in_scope: No anti-emulation policy, monitoring/refusal policy or random-crash repair. Do not drop any real/relocated constructor.
